operation_checks.parent_context: scratch state root; the installed Claude desktop engine 2.1.309; no model input
operation_checks.scope: Bridge-side first-use approval on a scratch state root: private bundle copy, codesign requirement (team Q6L2SF6YDW, identifier com.anthropic.claude-code) and sandboxed --version passed in 2.37 s; the exact-hash approval check the hook uses took 0.10 s; no temporary copy left

findings: The desktop session transcript (92338fcb) shows the NativePeers SessionStart hook ran in the desktop engine and refused registration ("NativePeers registration unavailable: PeerError") before this change.
Claude Code installs a copy of a directory-marketplace plugin and its update keys on the version alone.
limitations: Desktop behavior (AC9) is verified only by the person after install.
Whether the desktop engine gives SessionStart hooks CLAUDE_ENV_FILE (needed for npeer commands from its Bash tool) is unverified; np:* delegation does not depend on it.

independent_review.note: The reviewer could not run unit tests (read-only sandbox without a writable temporary directory); its findings rest on source and control-flow inspection.

findings.summary: An unapproved desktop engine nearer in the ancestry was skipped, letting an enclosing approved owner be borrowed (hook, nearest_native, bind_caller).
findings.disposition: FIXED in c7a5d4d: every desktop engine copy is a native boundary; an unapproved nearest boundary refuses. Test: test_an_unapproved_desktop_engine_is_a_boundary_never_searched_past.

findings.summary: First-use approval inside the SessionStart hook could exceed its installed three-second timeout.
findings.disposition: FIXED in c7a5d4d: the hook never approves; the np bridge approves an unapproved engine on first use (2.37 s on the real engine) and registers through the hook path. Tests: test_the_bridge_approves_on_first_use_and_registers_a_mirror_only_parent, test_the_bridge_registers_only_below_an_unapproved_desktop_engine.

findings.summary: Hash-only approval keys blocked identical bytes at a second build path.
findings.disposition: FIXED in c7a5d4d: records keyed by exact path with the SHA-256 inside. Test: test_identical_bytes_at_another_path_get_their_own_approval.

findings.summary: An unsuccessful --version invocation was recorded as a permanent unsupported-version refusal.
findings.disposition: FIXED in c7a5d4d: only a definite signature failure or an unsupported version from a successful run is recorded. Test: test_only_a_definite_failure_is_recorded_and_an_unsuccessful_check_is_retried.

findings.summary: A recorded plugin installation whose files were removed counted as up to date.
findings.disposition: FIXED in c7a5d4d: a missing installPath directory is reinstalled. Test: test_an_installed_copy_that_differs_from_the_checkout_is_refreshed_and_an_equal_one_is_left.
